data.name: Inspired Assault [Enchantment]
data.description: As a standard action, you can inspire a living creature with a touch by expending 1 point of mental focus. The creature receives a +%1 morale bonus on attack rolls. This bonus also applies on saving throws against fear effects. This bonus lasts for 1 minute.|1+OccultistLVL/6
